content.title: Said Hamdine Mixed-Use Development — 202 Apartments
summary: A five-block mixed-use development in Said Hamdine, Algiers, delivering 202 market-rate apartments on a steeply sloping site, with three commercial mezzanine levels and one basement parking level.
The most demanding engineering challenge was the site topography: the massing was stepped across the slope to create active street-level commercial frontage and secure underground parking.
description: Five residential blocks rise over three commercial mezzanine levels and a single basement parking level. The steeply sloping site required specialist retaining structures and precise foundation engineering to resolve level changes across the development.
The project was executed under a full all-trades contract, covering structural concrete, facade works, glazing systems, and integrated site roads and utility networks. Completed in 2023.
content.authority: A mixed-use urban development defined by structural engineering, integrated circulation, and complex site-grading execution.
